name: sisyphus
title: sisyphus
blurb: a side-scrolling myth simulator: push the boulder up the mountain, leap chasms and scree, shove off the crows. get hit and it doesn't just cost a life — the boulder rolls back down the slope and undoes your climb. six palettes, live-synthesized audio, no build step. @dulanyw.bsky.social asked for this one.
